what: When a hand or keyboard focus lands on a name line below (product·brand names), the base panel (logo and one-line statement) on the center stage turns off .09s late over .4s ease-in-out, and the paired panel for that name (a rotating product video) turns on in the same spot over the same duration, with the video playing from the start. When the focus leaves the name, the base panel returns and all videos stop. On a one-screen first page with a single stage, just sweeping across the names shows the products in turn. fx:off and fx:on are fired at the parts inside the base panel (cell logo)

options.wide: Switches by overlapping only at this width (px) or more, default 960 — below that the consuming css stacks the panels
options.--fx-dur: Duration of the panel fading out and in (via style), default .4s
options.--fx-delay: Pause before switching off and on (via style), default .09s
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Interaction name — picks the paired panel by data-key (by order if absent)
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Panel paired with the name — data-key, inside it <video> It spins when on and stops when off
options.[data-fx-part=base]: (if present) base panel kept on when no name has interaction

use:
Logo / Statement
Name A
note: Overlapping panels (position:absolute in the same cell) is handled by the consuming side’s css — the part only does on and off and video. On narrow screens without hover, the original stacks the panels vertically and labels each video

from.where: index.html .bx-home — original .sections-container .section (opacity .4s ease-in-out .09s, .visible) · on brand link mouseenter·focus that panel’s video.play(), on mouseleave·blur the base panel and all videos pause, 960px and up
